name: z0r0z V4 Router hardcoded calldata-offset payer check bypass
summary: UniswapV4Router04.swap(bytes data, uint256 deadline) checks the payer with inline assembly comparing calldataload(164) to caller(), assuming the data bytes argument always sits at offset 0x40. Because ABI encoding lets a dynamic argument's offset point elsewhere, an attacker crafts calldata that places their own address at byte 164 to pass the check while the decoded BaseData.payer is a victim who had approved the router. The router then pulls the victim's tokens and sends the swap output to an attacker-named receiver. Sixteen addresses drained 30 approved victims across 54 transactions.

loss.notes: Only the USDC leg is valued: 50,908.522937 USDC pulled from 30 approved victims to attacker-named receivers across 30 of the 54 campaign transactions (blocks 24575085..24619337), valued at par. The same campaign also moved 14 other tokens the router was approved for (2,942,232 PURR, 3,196,624 WOWSTR, 475,318 10KWHL, 131,710 MOONSTR, 120,388 PEPEp, 39,057 NWTKN, 31,198 999WHL, 419.8 MD, 5.9 PNKSTR, 1.9 PENDLE, 0.63 EUL, 0.22 DFYT, 2.17e-5 ZKC, 0.0001 WETH); DefiLlama returns no price for the illiquid memecoins, and the priced non-USDC legs total under 4 USD, so they are not added to the USD figure. Realised at the last campaign transaction 0x4578c93b (block 24619337).

ageReset.description: Direct immutable router; the assembly payer check is in the deployed runtime and no configuration bears on it. The router is a stateless singleton (Etherscan reports it as its own implementation); creatorAddress is the CreateX-side factory 0xbdd24cbb that ran the CREATE.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Verified UniswapV4Router04 source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=1, v0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a, optimizer 9999999, cancun; SHA-256 of SourceCode f24dfd69046c685ea5681d58df10b601ec4f7be17dd19e976facd0aabbeb0ef9), src/UniswapV4Router04.sol swap(bytes,uint256): the setMsgSender modifier runs, then assembly `if iszero(eq(calldataload(164), caller())) revert Unauthorized()`, i.e. it reads the word at byte 0xa4 and assumes the bytes payload's BaseData.payer lives there (offset 0x40). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 24575085, index 181, EOA 0xd6b7e831 -> helper 0xded262d0): swap data carries bytes offset 0xc0, placing 0xded262d0 at byte 164 (passing caller()) while the tail encodes payer 0x65a8f07bd9a8598e1b5b6c0a88f4779dbc077675, whose 42606.959179 USDC the router pulls (receipt) and swaps, with the WETH output withdrawn to the attacker. First exercise: trace_filter to the router over blocks 22281170..24620000 (10k windows, 1k for the few that overflowed) yields 61 swap(bytes) (selector 0xaf2b4aba) calls; ABI-decoding each, 60 in 54 transactions have BaseData.payer (word at data-offset+3) != the caller, first source-1 at block 24575085 (the two direct swap(bytes) calls in the whole earlier history have payer == caller). Artifact: eth_getCode 0x at 22281169; keccak256 0xfb64a1e736740e62892202c79f564689bee0633ab3315ac0a63e985ae2057e2e at 22281170 and 24575084; source-2 (block 22281170, index 46, EOA 0x1c0aa8cc via CreateX 0xba5ed099...): callTracer shows CreateX CREATE2 to 0x000000...15aa which the CreateX deployer runs, and 0xbdd24cbb CREATEs the router last in a batch of 27; the router's runtime has DELEGATECALL (to the v4 PoolManager) but no SELFDESTRUCT and no upgrade path (Etherscan lists it as its own implementation). Deployment supplies the age.

Reviewed loss. For each of the 54 payer!=caller swap(bytes) transactions the receipt ERC-20 Transfer logs whose from == the decoded victim payer were summed by token: USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 totals 50908522937 base units (6 decimals) from 30 distinct victims across 30 transactions. The USDC is valued at par. DefiLlama historical prices at each token's first-drain timestamp return no quote for the 12 memecoin legs (PURR, WOWSTR, 10KWHL, MOONSTR, PEPEp, NWTKN, 999WHL, ZKC, DFYT and others) and value PENDLE, EUL, MD, PNKSTR and 0.0001 WETH at under 4 USD combined, so only USDC is counted toward the USD figure; the other tokens are additional gross victim depletion listed in the loss note.
